title: 11 Cases which were declared false, non-cognizable, or which were due to a mistake of fact or law or which were undetected or in which the investigation was refused or in which the accused died or was declared insane or remained under investigation amounted to 547584. Charge sheets were submitted in 287247 cases. Trials were completed in 242108 cases, of which 157879 cases ended in conviction and 84229 in acquittal or discharge. The percentage of cases in which charge-sheets were laid to total true cases was 55.4 (52.5 of 1959), of cases convicted to cases in which trial was completed was 65.2 (64.2 of 1959) and of acquittal to cases in which trial was completed 34.8 (35.8 of 1959).
